notes: Window on MAX(poline.LastEditedWhen, po.LastEditedWhen): (@LastCutoff, @NewCutoff]. PO 1 effective 2020-01-20 (5 outers x QtyPerOuter 10 = 50, IsOrderLineFinalized=1); PO 2 effective 2020-02-20 (3 x 12 = 36, IsOrderLineFinalized=0). ORDER BY PurchaseOrderID.

cases.name: jan-finalized
cases.why: Jan window -> PO 1: [Ordered Quantity] = 5*10 = 50, [Is Order Finalized]=1 (the finalized bit arm).

cases.name: feb-not-finalized
cases.why: Feb window -> PO 2: [Ordered Quantity] = 3*12 = 36, [Is Order Finalized]=0 (the not-finalized arm).

cases.name: both-months
cases.why: Both POs ordered by PurchaseOrderID -> both OrderedOuters*QuantityPerOuter products and both bit arms.

cases.name: lower-boundary-exclusive
cases.why: LastCutoff equals PO 1's effective timestamp -> PO 1 excluded (> bound), PO 2 remains.
